title: Mem2A intent
description: What an agent is about to do, the things it touches, and who it is acting for. Sent by the agent as a data part with mediaType `application/vnd.mem2a.intent+json` in the first message of a task.

action.description: A short, stable identifier for the kind of action, for example `send_quote` or `update_leadership`. Memory may map it to company policy.

summary.description: The action in one plain sentence, for example `Send Acme a renewal quote`.

draft.description: Optional: the content the agent plans to send or change, so memory can check it against precedent and constraints. Confidential to this task.

deadline.description: Optional: when the agent intends to act by.
